name: S3 Huahin Hotel
detail: Checked in almost at 11 PM, there were still reception staff available. A cash deposit of 300 for the key card. The family suite on the 5th floor has two large beds, spacious and clean room, wide bathroom, strong water flow. The WiFi is very strong, reaching across the street. There is a service to refill drinking water and clean before 3 PM. The breakfast buffet is available from 7:00 AM, with main menu items including fried rice, chicken porridge, scrambled eggs, ham, sausage, salad, pad Thai, bread, and fresh coffee. The indoor swimming pool is on the 3rd floor, not very deep, at 1.1 meters. Very comfortable and quiet. Checked out just after 5 AM, almost 6 AM, and there was still reception staff available to return the key card deposit. Initially, I read many reviews on Google with various comments, but after staying myself, I felt it was quite okay. If I have the chance, I will definitely stay here again next time.

name: RELO' The Urban Escape
detail: At first, I saw comments saying that it was not close to the city center and that taking a taxi was inconvenient. Since I wasn't driving, I hesitated to book. Later, I did a lot of research and found that it was actually easy to book a taxi, so I decided to go ahead! Firstly, in terms of transportation, Grab is easy to use, but it takes about 30 minutes to get to the city. If you plan to frequently eat or play in the city, it might not be very suitable. Secondly, the hardware facilities are great; there is a swimming pool and a gym, and the gym overlooks the sea, which is fantastic! However, the room is smaller than I expected, but the balcony faces the sea, which is absolutely beautiful! The bathroom is also quite large; although the decor is not very fancy or Instagrammable, it's sufficient! Additionally, the complimentary spa has a buy one get one free offer, which I highly recommend. It's not expensive, and the experience is great; the massage was very comfortable! Lastly, the breakfast was actually quite good over the two days; the variety was rich and the taste was nice! One small complaint is that the laundry service provided is too expensive, so I ended up taking my laundry back to Bangkok to wash.
area: Hua Hin Beachfront,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: The Yana Villas Hua Hin
detail: I stayed at a hotel in mid-July recently. This hotel is a small one located right by Khao Takiab beach. The beach is beautiful, and you can walk along the shoreline to enjoy the breeze as far as the eye can see. My first impression was the warm welcome from the front desk staff. After parking, they came to help carry our bags with a friendliness that we could feel. In terms of the reception, although there were only two people working, they were efficient. The welcome drink here is chrysanthemum tea, which is delicious and refreshing after the journey. Our room was in the front building, facing the street, beautifully decorated for our birthday. The sleeping area is one room, the bathroom is one room with a shower, and there’s a bathtub outside. Going down below, there is a pool villa area and a restaurant (where we had breakfast) and a swimming pool. The view in front is very beautiful, and you can access the beach directly. The staff serving breakfast were very friendly. You could feel the freshness of their service. The breakfast was up to hotel standards, complete and with a moderate taste. In terms of cleanliness in the room, I would give it 4 stars. I still found some hair and stains in the sink. Lastly, after going outside, our key card had a problem, but the front desk coordinated with the technician and was able to resolve it in the end. I was impressed with every aspect of the hotel, both the location and the service. If given the opportunity, I would go back to stay again.

name: Amari Hua Hin
detail: The hotel is close to the Chikada market and the Tamarind market, and it's walkable. There is parking in front of the hotel and an underground parking lot. The front is simply decorated but looks nice and elegant, with a welcome drink of chrysanthemum tea mixed with lemongrass. I booked a Deluxe Pool View King room through Agoda for just over two thousand baht. The room is large and very clean, with a clearly separated bathroom and shower area. The outside balcony is spacious and actually usable for sitting and relaxing. The swimming pool is large and clean. The breakfast buffet has quite a variety, with plenty of pastries and good flavors. The hotel is not by the beach, but they provide a shuttle service to the beach (which is not far from the hotel). It is very worthwhile compared to the price. My partner and I were very impressed. I recommend it for anyone looking for accommodation in the city center near tourist attractions.

name: Maven Stylish Hotel Hua Hin
detail: I was impressed with the stay. The location was convenient for traveling and getting to various points easily. The room was clean, with complete amenities, and I slept well. It was worth the money spent.

name: NH Hua Hin
detail: The room was clean, the atmosphere inside the hotel was nice. It's not beachfront, but you can walk across to the beach. It's within walking distance to Bluport and close to convenience stores. There are restaurants near the hotel. The parking is a bit limited. The small gym gets crowded with just 4-5 people, but there are still facilities available. I didn't use the pool because I went during the monsoon, but the view was nice. The breakfast is a buffet with a good variety of food. The staff provided good service, always smiling and friendly. We left our phone at the restaurant in the morning, and a staff member kept it for us. Thank you very much! Overall, it was great and the price was reasonable. If I have the opportunity, I will definitely stay again.

name: City Beach Resort
detail: I have stayed here many times. Even though it's an old hotel, it's definitely safe because it's right next to the police station. It's convenient to get around, close to the train station, walking distance to the beach, and the night market. You can also walk to restaurants and cafes, or just call a Grab, which is convenient. I will definitely come back again.

name: ibis Hua Hin
detail: A guest-friendly place with excellent service from staff, starting with the receptionist and security personnel in the parking lot. The amenities around the accommodation are good. The exterior may not look new, but the interior is well-maintained. The bed is comfortable, and the air conditioning is cool. Although the hairdryer in the room was broken, it was quickly addressed by the staff and housekeeping. I would like to commend and recommend this place. :)
